'''Nisa''' is the stout mare that belongs to [[Barmellin]], who lives near [[Tremonsien]]. Frightened by the glow of the [[Choedan Kal]], Barmellin turns Nisa back to his farm and drives her as hard as she will go.{{ref/book|9|35}}
